request.prompt:

Must be shown, exactly as written: No scars or other distinguishing physical marks are established. Do not add a signature scar, tattoo, or other fixed mark. `(characters.md)`

Not established, so your choice: Ada may be shown looking toward Keel rather than toward Oasis, reflecting the established visual contrast between her attention and Alex’s. `(characters.md)`

Must not appear: Do not add scars or other distinguishing marks not established in the files.

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
